description: Public-safe tool module registry. Use this to decide which internal workflow modules are ready to become GitHub/tool repos.
rules: Use synthetic or public demo data only.
Do not include client inboxes, CRM exports, credentials, browser profiles, private reports, or raw customer files.
A module is GitHub-ready only after README, MANIFEST, PRIVACY, VALIDATION, license, and smoke test are clean.

modules.name: Lead Intake Fast Reply
modules.purpose: Turn messy inbound lead data into triage, suggested reply, priority, missing fields, and a human approval checklist.
modules.publicBoundary: Use synthetic leads only. Never publish real prospect inboxes, CRM exports, phone numbers, compose URLs, or customer messages.

modules.name: Client Status Radar
modules.purpose: Summarize customer/project state, stale follow-ups, open loops, risks, and next best action from local exports.
modules.publicBoundary: Use fake customers and sanitized workflow notes only. Never publish real client names, live pipeline data, emails, or private decisions.

modules.name: Workflow Briefing Layer
modules.purpose: Convert scattered process notes into a concise daily work briefing, blockers, approvals needed, and suggested next moves.
modules.publicBoundary: Use public/sample process notes only. Never publish private operational logs, customer-specific SOPs, or sensitive business strategy.
